dedupe_keys.name: itu r report bt 2140 15 transition from analogue to digital terrestrial television broadcasting 2026

description: Report ITU-R BT.2140 collects guidance on moving terrestrial television from analogue to digital, and its fifteenth edition (approved March 2026, 187 pages, English only) is in force. Part 1 covers why and how to go digital (technical, commercial and regulatory considerations), an overview of broadcasting technologies and digital terrestrial television systems, regulatory considerations, efficient use of spectrum, requirements for television services, interoperability, market impact, general strategy and coordination, equipment components, benefits, mobile reception, interference aspects and transition issues. Producer: ITU-R Study Group 6, with earlier editions listed as superseded (for example those of 2019, 2021 and 2023). Coverage: worldwide, with experience from many countries. Access: the ITU publication page lists a free download in PDF (7.1 MB) and Word. Licence and cost: free; ITU copyright notice applies. Caveats: it is guidance text, not measured data, and country experience varies in age. Simulation uses: it provides transition scenarios and planning parameters for scenario models of broadcast spectrum and coverage. Related records: none linked; the SFN design report BT.2386 is a companion technical guide.
